# Project Overview {.unnumbered}

This document records the computational work for the project: *Evaluating Quality Control (QC) Tools for Oxford Nanopore Sequencing (ONT) Sequencing Data Analysis*.

## Recommendation System & Scoring Framework

- **[QC Tool Recommendation Dashboard](tool_weighting.html):** Interactive multi-criteria recommendation dashboard for selecting long-read QC/trimming strategies.
- **[Methods & Robustness Guide](methods_and_robustness.html):** Comprehensive mathematical formulations, policy calibrations, provenance, and empirical stability evidence (Scoring Specification 1.0).
- **[Specification #10](https://github.com/adimascf/biox7021/issues/10):** Issue #10 interactive recommendation system and scoring specification.

## Core Objectives

1.  **Systematic Benchmarking:** Evaluate fastplong, Porechop, Dorado, and Barbell on real bacterial ONT datasets.
2.  **Downstream Impact Assessment:** Measure the effect of the pre processing step on:
    - Variant calling (DeepVariant / Clair3)
    - Assembly quality (Flye / Raven)

## Metrics for Evaluation

- **Variant Calling:** F1 score, precision, recall,
- **Assembly:** Structural accuracy, sequence accuracy, contamination, contigs recovery
